caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher positioned centrally on an off-white or lightly yellowed background. The pitcher is rendered in black and gray tones, suggesting graphite or pencil as the drawing medium. It has a rounded body that tapers towards the base, an extended pouring spout, and an upwardly curved handle attached near the spout and looping high above the rim before curving back to the body. The rim of the pitcher is embellished with a row of decorative bead-like elements. The base is flared out and rests on a square plinth with matching beaded ornamentation around its edges. There are no other objects or decorative elements present on the sheet, and the pitcher is positioned so that it is fully visible with all details clearly rendered. In the lower right corner, text and a small scale indicate the drawing's scale and the pitcher’s actual dimensions.
title: Silver Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
